facts.fact: Tunisian authorities plan TND 1.07 billion (about USD 356.8 million per Agence Ecofin) for the Ministry of Communication Technologies in the 2027 budget, presented by the minister to two parliamentary committees.
The 2027 budget proposed for the Ministry of Communication Technologies, TND 1.07 billion, is 9.3% above the previous year's.
The Ministry of Communication Technologies says more than 40 services are currently available on the Khadamet application and targets 150.
